title: Passive Voice
voiceover: Bugünün konusu Passive Voice. Formül: BE artı V3. Am, is, are, was, were, will be. Bunlardan birini görürsen dur. Cümlede BY varsa Passive sinyali. The door was closed by him. Was closed, BE artı V3, Passive. Will be artı V1 olmaz, her zaman V3. Daha fazlası için sinyal-avcisi.com. Odaklan ve kazan.

slides.title: PASSIVE VOICE
slides.formula:
BE + V3
am / is / are / was / were / will be
slides.example: The door was closed by him.
slides.tip:
Cümlede BY varsa → Passive sinyali.
Will be + V1 ASLA olmaz, her zaman V3.
